import Aesop

theorem ternary_prefix_decode
  (n d x : ℕ)
  
  (h : Nat.digits 3 x = d :: (List.replicate n 2 ++ [1])) :
  x = d + 3 * (2 * Finset.sum (Finset.range n) (fun i => 3 ^ i) + 3 ^ n) := by
  have h_ofDigits : Nat.ofDigits 3 (Nat.digits 3 x) = x := Nat.ofDigits_digits 3 x
  have h_rep : ∀ k, Nat.ofDigits 3 (List.replicate k 2 ++ [1]) = 2 * Finset.sum (Finset.range k) (fun i => 3 ^ i) + 3 ^ k := by
    intro k
    induction' k with k ih
    · simp [Nat.ofDigits]
    · rw [List.replicate_succ, List.cons_append, Nat.ofDigits_cons, ih]
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
      have hpow : (fun i => 3 ^ (i + 1)) = (fun i => 3 * 3 ^ i) := by
        funext i
        rw [pow_succ', mul_comm]
      rw [hpow, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      simp only [pow_zero, pow_succ']
      ring
  rw [← h_ofDigits, h, Nat.ofDigits_cons, h_rep]
